clampEdit.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this existing product photograph for a white-background industrial tooling gallery. Remove ONLY the brand logo and certification graphics in the top margin, and replace the pale gray tabletop/background with clean pure white. Preserve the actual black press brake upper-punch quick clamp and its exact geometry, all existing fasteners and mounting holes, the red lever, the smaller red safety plate, angles, relative dimensions, metal finish and orientation. Do not invent or delete any screw, hole, jaw, plate, handle or feature. Keep the complete product including all edges visible, with a small soft contact shadow. No text, no logos, no watermarks, no certification symbols. This is a photographic background cleanup, not a new clamp design. Output a high-resolution square photograph without changing the product.
